# Pulse task #2864: Add Zoom to Fit and Zoom Back controls with Z/X in Arrange and clip editors

Operation: 962d511f823547f543641378041bfa17
Assignee: PORTALSURFER (Pulse #1, GitHub ID 41680373)

User19October2026: add zoom-to-fit controls like Ableton Live X/Z for both Arrange and clip editor. Live12 official manual checked19October: https://www.ableton.com/en/manual/arrangement-view/ and https://www.ableton.com/en/live-manual/12/clip-view/ describe Z fit current time selection and X return to previous zoom. Use original Hex theme/shared controls, no copied assets. Duplicate live zoom-title search found no matching issue; existing track-height H2827 and track-header sizing2714 are separate.

Provide discoverable compact Zoom to Fit/selection and Zoom Back buttons in each view plus equivalent Z and X shortcuts scoped to the active Arrange or audio/MIDI clip editor. Z fits the applicable nonempty time selection; where no time selection exists, use selected clip bounds (full current clip in clip editor) and an explicit whole-content fallback if nothing eligible is selected, reusing actual current zoom/frame bounds. Normalize reversed selections, prevent zero/overflow/NaN viewports and honor minimum span. Inspect existing selection and zoom commands before finalizing this fallback; do not invent a model edit to achieve navigation.

X restores the viewport from before the last fit in THAT view/document/clip context. Keep view histories independent, bounded and reset/rebased on project/clip replacement so old coordinates cannot leak into a different owner. Follow existing viewport/navigation owner patterns rather than a new generic undo/history framework. Navigation must not create canonical musical Undo entries, change clips/loop/playhead/grid or start playback. Preserve existing mouse/trackpad/ruler zoom/pan, H height overview and CmdZUndo. Actual typing in text/numeric/search/name/IME or musical keyboard mode must not trigger these view shortcuts. Button hover/disabled state clear and stable at compact widths.

Acceptance actual rendered button and key dispatch for Arrange and BOTH audio/MIDI editors: fit selected range/clip, empty fallback, restore exact prior viewport, repeat fitting, separate contexts, stale/document/clip replacement, zoom bounds, editorfocus/textIME/musicaltyping protection and no project/history mutation. Keep grid painting/snapping and waveform/note geometry consistent after zoom. Proportional focused local checks then solemerger full exact qualification/review/merge. Root later optimized native input/appearance checklist; no app/install/quit/native action by worker. Ready for Review only actual merge.

Related sameuser request reflects Arrange time selection into clip editor and prevents time-selection switching to device panel; track as focused separate linked tickets. The user was asked whether reflection should also autozoom; that optional policy belongs to that reflection ticket, not a reason to pause this explicit zoom-control work. Existing general worker queues after current310/455 andnewresize/UI requests, preserve3ongoingworkers and canonical intake/attach/source identity.
